name: AI 실험실
concept: Premium stage + scrappy doodles + felt otter mascot. Data and titles move smoothly (springs); doodles jitter in stop-motion (8-12 fps) on top; the otter reacts at key moments.

captions.long: bottom bar, Pretendard SemiBold 42px, dark translucent box
captions.short: karaoke bold: Black Han Sans 84px, white with 14px black outline, spoken word turns captionHighlight

thumbnail: big-number: huge accent number + 2-4 words + otter pose + one crude red circle

poses.idle: default, listening while the narration explains
poses.cheer: both arms up: success, the big number lands
poses.shy: blushing, hands on cheeks: cute or slightly embarrassing result
poses.calm: eyes closed: zen, waiting, slow process running
poses.thinking: paw on chin: hypothesis, comparing options
poses.jump: leaping with joy: the experiment worked, best result of the episode
poses.blush: rosy cheeks, eyes closed smiling: flattered, adorable result, thank-you to viewers
poses.gasp: paws on cheeks + marks: shocking number, 'no way'
poses.confused: question mark: weird output, 'why?', setting up a question for the viewer
poses.worried: teary eyes, paw at mouth: risk, cost warning, it might fail
poses.angry: frown + anger mark: bug, rate limit, bad answer, frustrating tool
poses.peek: leaning in sideways: sneak peek, 'look at this', curiosity before a reveal
poses.sleepy: sitting, zzz: boring part, long wait, slow model
poses.nap: curled up asleep: very long job (overnight render, training), time skip
poses.explain: pointer stick: teaching a concept, walking through a diagram or steps
poses.idea: light bulb: key insight, tip, 'here's the trick'
poses.search: magnifying glass: investigating, zoom on detail, research, debugging
poses.note: notepad + pencil: summary, checklist, key takeaways, memo
poses.reading: open book: docs, papers, reading the manual or a release note
poses.laptop: laptop with play icon: demo, watching the screen, subscribe/watch next
poses.coffee: warm cup, content smile: break, relaxed recap, 'while it runs...'
poses.explorer: safari hat + vest: new tool exploration, 'let's explore', field test
poses.graduate: cap and gown: tutorial complete, mastered it, series finale, level up
poses.pajamas: nightcap + PJs: late-night build, overnight experiment, good-night outro
poses.cozy: knit cardigan: calm talk, retrospective, seasonal/cozy episode

mascot.source: cut from the user's reference images (assets/mascot/source: otter-sheet.webp for set 1, otter-set2/ for set 2)
